Solution to Russian Brunch

by Andrew Thomas

At brunch, guests were served five dishes with unexpected ingredients:

Bacon       with Sesame
Eggs        with oNions
Hash browns with spInach
Pancakes    with tofFee
Waffles     with cornFlakes

Alphabetize the names of the dishes and then read down the diagonal of the names of the extra ingredients. You find the answer SNIFF.

2006 MIT Mystery Hunt
